notes: Doors: opening a door on a server no longer turns its top half into a second bottom half.
Beds: you lie down and get the sleep screen on servers, and sleeping skips the night.
Jukeboxes play music now - every disc, including Pigstep and otherside. A disc downloads the first time you play it.
Crafting 4 logs gives real Wood blocks instead of a purple and black block, and they keep their bark when placed.
Lilac, rose bush, tall grass and large fern show their top half on servers.
Buttons and levers placed on the floor stay on the floor instead of sticking to a wall.
The game updates itself: when a new version is out you get a warning, your world is saved, and the page reloads. These notes show after each update.
